reference:
The annual event held in several major cities in Finland is the "Night of the Arts," which is one of many White Night festivals. The White Nights are a kind of all-night arts festival held in many cities in the summer, with the "white nights" being the name given in areas of high latitude to the weeks around the summer solstice in June during which sunsets are late, sunrises are early, and darkness is never complete.

FINDING: Night of the Arts festival occurs during the "white nights" period.
